grid.expression: SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.NUMNOTA, CAB.CODTIPOPER, (SELECT MAX(DESCROPER) FROM TGFTOP TOP WHERE TOP.CODTIPOPER=CAB.CODTIPOPER) AS TOP, ITE.CODPROD, (CASE WHEN ITE.CODLOCALORIG = 101 THEN CAB.AD_CODLOCALDEST ELSE ITE.CODLOCALORIG END) CODLOCAL, (SELECT LOC.DESCRLOCAL FROM TGFLOC LOC WHERE LOC.CODLOCAL= (CASE WHEN ITE.CODLOCALORIG = 101 THEN CAB.AD_CODLOCALDEST ELSE ITE.CODLOCALORIG END)) AS LOCAL, (SELECT DESCRPROD FROM TGFPRO PRO WHERE ITE.CODPROD=PRO.CODPROD) AS DESCRICAO, (SELECT P.RAZAOSOCIAL FROM TGFPAR P WHERE P.CODPARC = (SELECT CODPARCFORN FROM TGFPRO PRO WHERE ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD)) AS FORNECEDORPREF, ITE.QTDNEG FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA WHERE TRUNC(CAB.DTENTSAI) >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND TRUNC(CAB.DTENTSAI) <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND CAB.CODTIPOPER = :P_CODTIPOPER ORDER BY CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.NUNOTA, ITE.CODPROD

SELECT DISTINCT ITE.CODPROD, (SELECT DESCRPROD FROM TGFPRO PRO WHERE ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD) AS DESCRICAO, SUM(ITE.QTDNEG) AS QTD FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA WHERE TRUNC(CAB.DTENTSAI) >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND TRUNC(CAB.DTENTSAI) <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND CAB.CODTIPOPER = :P_CODTIPOPER GROUP BY ITE.CODPROD
